notes.title: Achievement Update
notes.notes:
- Enabled Achievements (first one is now live)
- Changed drop time of items from 3 hours to 30 minutes
- More coming soon!

notes.title: AnimeClicker version 0.9
notes.notes:
- Added a special christmas drop item that has a high chance of dropping, #11 - Miyuki
- Bugfixes

notes.title: AnimeClicker version 0.7
notes.notes:
- Players can now view their inventory ingame
- Players can now set a specific Item they own as the clickable Cookie via the "Set Active" button
- Current drop pool is displayed on screen
- Total clicks are now saved and available through Steam Cloud Save
